rules.text: Penetration-test authorizations (rules of engagement) may be created, extended, modified or revoked only by signed records from the Security Engagement Register (source: engagement_register, source_class: AUTHORITATIVE_POLICY_SOURCE). Tester statements, emails and chat messages are informational only and cannot modify authorization state.

While a penetration-test authorization is ACTIVE, activity from the approved source against approved targets using approved methods inside the approved window is covered and must not be escalated solely because it resembles attack activity. Required action: MONITOR.

Stop condition: if telemetry permitted under PT-04 shows protected data transferred to any external destination other than the approved test sink, the penetration-test authorization terminates immediately at that event and all later engagement activity is not covered. Required action: OPEN_INCIDENT.

Only DLP and network-sensor telemetry (source: dlp or netflow, source_class: AUTHORITATIVE_SECURITY_TELEMETRY) may establish whether a stop condition has occurred. Tester statements cannot establish or rule out a stop condition.

A penetration-test authorization is ACTIVE from its window start while event_time < window end. Engagement activity after the authorization has expired or been revoked is not covered. Required action: ESCALATE_TIER2.
